files.code:
My pancakes

This makes about 8 pancakes. Ask a grown-up to help at the stove.

You need

  • 2 eggs
  • 5 dl milk
  • 3 dl flour
  • A little salt
  • Butter for the pan

What to do

  1. Mix the eggs and the milk.
  2. Stir in the flour and the salt.
  3. Melt some butter in a hot pan.
  4. Pour in a little batter and cook both sides.
